title: Hearty Sweet Spanish White Chocolate Empanadas
description: A sweet and gooey Spanish dish featuring white chocolate chips, perfect for kids and lacto-vegetarian friendly, with a resinous and sweet flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sifted flour, granulated sugar, and salt.
Add the melted unsalted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of white chocolate chips in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half circle and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Dust the empanadas with confectioners sugar and serve warm.
